report.summary: Patient P-D005 (age 34, commercial Employer HMO, no transport benefit) lives in census tract 17031241400. The most recent social-needs screener (2026-10-22) did not flag transportation or utilities shutoff as active problems. The clinic requested community resource options for utilities and transport needs. Utilities: Shutoff Prevention Clinic offers walk-in help with disconnection notices on Tuesdays (no stated income restriction); Neighborhood Energy Help offers income-based help with gas and electric bills, apply in person Mon/Wed (income eligibility not verifiable without patient income data). Transport: Medicaid Ride Line is for Medicaid plan members only (patient has commercial coverage — not eligible); Senior Shuttle West is for adults 60+ (patient is 34 — not eligible); Paratransit Info Desk is for ADA paratransit certification applicants (decision up to 21 days). Tract has 23.3% no-vehicle households and 60 transit stops within 800m, so public transit is an option for appointments.
